title: MFA Step-Up Error
description: Error envelope for a failed step-up check on DELETE /api/v1/mfa/disable and GET /api/v1/mfa/backup-codes. Messages are generic and never echo the supplied code.

error_code.description: MFA_STEP_UP_REQUIRED = HTTP 400 (no/malformed code); MFA_STEP_UP_INVALID = HTTP 401 (wrong code); MFA_STEP_UP_ERROR = HTTP 500 (verification failed internally).
